features.title: APK association
features.what: After file association double click installs APK.
features.evidence_quote: 注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK

features.title: App window
features.what: Apps launch in a separate resizable window.
features.evidence_quote: 每个安卓应用都有自己的窗口，可拖动、缩放、固定在任务栏。

features.title: Runtime
features.what: Android tools and QEMU support the runtime.
features.evidence_quote: 自动装好 adb / QEMU / 安卓系统镜像

features.title: ARM compatibility
features.what: ARM only apps may need native translation.
features.evidence_quote: 若应用仅含 ARM 原生库，需要运行时支持 ARM 转译

risks.text: One-time runtime setup; ARM-only compatibility is not guaranteed.
